sources.name: Immigrant Services Society of BC (ISSofBC)
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress/tribe) confirmed live 2026-08-26 - JSON events[] with settlement/employment/multicultural programming (e.g. 'Multicultural Women's Support Group'). One of BC's largest settlement agencies; single best-fit practical source for this city.

sources.name: MOSAIC BC - Settlement & Employment Services
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress/tribe) confirmed live 2026-08-26 - JSON events[] including employment workshops (e.g. 'Cook and Connect Workshop', networking/job-search sessions). Multiple Metro Vancouver sites (head office 5575 Boundary Rd). Note: mosaicbc.org's separate 'engage' donor/volunteer subsite (engage.mosaicbc.org) is Squarespace, not this feed - use the wp-json route on the main domain.

sources.name: Vancouver Public Library
sources.notes: Runs BiblioCommons v2 (~2,104 event items with an Audience facet including 'Newcomers' and 'ESL Learners'), not Communico - the legacy vpl.libnet.info Communico widget is confirmed dead (genuinely zero events, not just unparsed), don't re-register as kind communico. New generic `bibliocommons` parser added 2026-09-09 (reads the SSR-embedded Redux state; also unlocked Halifax's library the same day) - confirmed working.

sources.name: UBC Vancouver Events Calendar
sources.notes: wp-json/tribe route returns Cloudflare 403 with browser UA/headers 2026-08-26 (bot-challenge, not a missing route) - unlike other tribe sites this one is actively blocked. International Student Advising posts orientation/workshop events here per UBC's own guide. Re-probe with different request timing/headers, or via a rendered-page scrape, before writing off.

sources.name: SFU Student Services
sources.notes: SFU's students.sfu.ca runs on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), not WordPress - wp-json route just serves the AEM shell page, no feed 2026-08-26. No recognized JSON/ical route found on a first pass.

sources.name: City of Vancouver Calendar of Events
sources.notes: Custom .aspx civic site (not Drupal/WordPress/Squarespace) 2026-08-26, no obvious JSON/REST route found on a first pass. The city's Open Data Portal (opendata.vancouver.ca) has permits/inspections datasets but nothing that maps to a curated public-events calendar - checked, not a fit.

sources.name: First Baptist Church Vancouver - ESL & Internationals
sources.notes: Standing weekly ESL Ministry (Thursdays 10:30am-12pm, pre-registration required) explicitly for internationals - contact via the Internationals/ESL coordinators listed on the page. No dated feed, term-based standing program only. Left with an empty manual event list per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.notes: Monthly gathering (1st Sunday, 12:45pm, following the 11:15am service) explicitly for international ESL students and work-permit holders. No dated feed - standing monthly program only. Left with an empty manual event list; worth hand-entering the next confirmed date.
